notes.title: The Superstore Update
notes.content:
General

New Characters

The Food Crew is available in the shoppe now!
   Includes 4 new characters and 2 hats!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/fdafd0eaf34fb9cfc1013ffb6f5e52845aaeeaf1.png


Lasertag

New Maps

No Foods Superstore
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/d34119125ea4d2a7f21cc46f55d0137ec026be2d.png
Brad's Top Secret Tropical Paradise
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/7f7c04c8c4616b2551293f6e9a18e3c14b527442.png

New Vehicles

Motorized Shopping Cart
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/67b31765e77d9a9c47f294d6c9e2e80dbb5d8eb4.png

New Gamemodes

Circle of Lava

A battle royale style zone closes in and moves across the map forcing the battle into tighter and tighter quarters!


New Weapons

Apple Cannon

Shoots apples.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/4bde478fe516c917ca333bae1b8668e259f16943.png

Pea Shooter

Shoots peas.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/6be9761a41d8b77b6ce1c8f68f03baf42aa95048.png

Lighting Carrot Sniper

Shoots carrots that were rubbed really fast to make static electricity!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/e612830ea8cc2baebbf01b9cb7f6a7d41d9cc189.png

The Invisible Cloak of Invisibility

Equip this to become invisible!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/c72ca4ef5024b924892f3eb3639aa08f3db324f3.png

Baguette

Fresh from the oven, and hard as a brick. This baguette packs a punch!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/7b41e2fc192d4a8eb6b82660edac7b6d6e522db8.png


Weapon Changes

Colors are hard, and sometimes putting the blue and red wires in the blue and red wire slots is a challenge. Everyone makes mistakes. Unfortunately for you, because mass producing drones is so hard, drones now have a 1/20 chance of turning on the owner. Just remember: colors are hard. It's not out fault.  
The Jolly Rodger, Cricket Pistol, and Musket now have better accuracy.
The Trooper of the Storm rifle was too accurate, so it's accuracy has been slightly decreased.
The Boogeyman shotgun now has increased range and fire rate.

Bug Fixes

Fixed Hella Cool rarity Lever Action Sniper's damage from 900 to 90.
Fixed levitating building in Jurassic Jungle map.
The raptor paddock in Jurassic Jungle is now properly electrified. 
Fixed issue where grappling with a grapple shotgun or getting electrocuted while on a vehicle would make you levitate.

General Improvements

You can now switch between first person and third person camera perspectives in the settings menu.
Scope sight now lines up with the actual scope of the weapon. This fixes having projectiles being shot out from the left side of the screen.
Slightly improved muzzle flash look.
Aiming now shifts the camera to the right so the weapon doesn't block your crosshair.
Aiming FOV shift matches physical camera movement speed to make aiming less jerky,
If you try to fire while the barrel of your weapon is clipping, you will be notified with a message.
If you die to a player that is already dead, it will show that kill as coming from the dead instead of 10,000+ meters.
You can now invert your X and Y camera movement in the settings menu.

notes.title: The Dinosaur Update
notes.content:
General

New Characters

Clever Girl

Comes with the Clever Girl Shotgun (Extended) (shown below).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/cb8f8017ad71a6abd876502d529feb7e29dc5a6f.png

Volume sliders now control linearly instead of logarithmically. This will allow for more precise volume adjustments instead of it being either too loud or too quiet. 

Because of this change, all volume adjustments have been reset to 90%.


Lasertag

New Maps

Jurassic Jungle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/987f5a4129f85d7cb39457da009b0f7ed0a5d651.png

New Vehicles

Dinosaur!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/641dfcc498f11610bf4ba448f4dfc9e0cd17cb0e.png
Jetpack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/ff519325480e2569c0507e8fe62869f2409d277a.png

New Weapons

Grapple Shotgun

New rare shotgun that allows you to fly towards your target before dealing massive damage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/d1d9b780723ad25b99f1e599d0f69b3ba9edb1cf.png

Taser

A pistol that does electrifies other players!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/62a71d0733e3ee76b1e9677503ee173182079c6d.png

Lever Action Sniper

A fast firing, accurate sniper.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/0129e2f0cbf2dbe63fa709b7d7aed788aaa9c2ae.png

The Happy Ending

Essentially just a big water gun...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/2def0e9980beb2342e8cfe85108b27e787360340.png

The Big Propane Tank

Same as a normal propane tank, but is 5x larger and has a much bigger boom!
Unlocks once you reach level 170.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/fc118522558c12fad2b2f2aefb9ebcb2c0ca9640.png

Clever Girl Shotgun (Extended)

The clever girl shotgun is more accurate and can shoot further when the stock is extended!
Available with the Clever Girl outfit (shown above).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/9aadfaa449ad8164ce1e101ed9712c1776c17dde.png


Bug Fixes

Fixed issue on projectiles that stuck to objects (arrows, darts, etc.) from continuing to play their fly audio upon getting stuck.
Fixed issues that arose when a player entered a match while a round was active.
Damage markers no longer show decimals.
Fixed the floating magnet that happens when the delivery balloons set the box on the ground.

General Improvements

Ghost camera fov set from 60 to 90.
Ghosts now have a crosshair and UI.
All non scoped and sighted weapons have a larger aimed in fov from 40 to 50.
Added a timer to show how long until the next round starts.
Removed compass and made health and juice values larger.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.8
notes.content:
Storymode

The Syrup bottle now grants 7x the meters you run in addition to the 7x meters you were awarded previously from collecting other collectibles with this power up. Your speed is also reduced by 10% to make it slightly easier. (Also, it's syrup, so logically, you can't run as fast.)

Lasertag

All damage and health in Lasertag has been multiplied by 10. There are now no more decimals.
The following weapons have increased damage:

Flame Thrower
Flare Gun
Firework Launcher
The Boogeyman
Bear Beater
Oversized Mouse Trap

Increased the fire rate on The Boogeyman shotgun.
Drone battery life decreased from 60 to 45 seconds.
Brick throw speed reduced by 50%.
Rounds now default to 3 instead of 1.

Selecting a random item now has a 1/1,000 chance that the random item will be the rare Super Duper Rapid Fire Rocket Launcher which will be unlocked if you are lucky enough to have this item show up in your inventory.

New setting Fire Cancels Reload which you can customize to have firing cancel reloading on all weapons, no weapons, or everything but shotguns that reload one shell at a time. This will default to cancel reloading on all weapons.

New Custom Options

Max Magazine Size 
Speed Multiplier
Reload Multiplier
Spread Multiplier
Recoil Multiplier
Kickback Multiplier

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.7
notes.content:
General

New Character: Lemon 

Comes with track 'Hella Cool Love Vibes'

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/430b773a9ccfcb6ab86d5ae4609b1b60ac493195.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/3082124850059f27ee8b401795a1e8fa1e73ba29.png

Lasertag

There is now a 'Claim All' button when opening the plastic eggs.
Weapon Changes

Fast Firing Weapons

Due to an issue with some fast firing weapons, the fire rates have to be lowered to not cause the game to break. The following weapons now have a decreased fire rate. Other stats have been adjusted to compensate for these fire rate changes.

The Mastodon (Dual Minigun) - 50 to 25
The Megalodon (Tri Minigun) - 75 to 25
Sprayer SMG - 35 to 25


Trigger and Proximity Drones

The drones now have a battery life of 1 minute! If not shot out of the sky within their battery life, they will explode.
Increased reload times on all rarities from 1 seconds to 7.
Fire rate decreased from 5 to 2 drones per second.

Air Bombardment

Reduced stack size from 2-10 to 1-3.
Increased reload times on all rarities from 1 seconds to 7.

The Musket, Jolly Rodger, and Cricket Pistol now have slightly reduced spread all around.

Bug Fixes

Fixed issue in Weapon Shoppe, where the items would wait until you left the shoppe to be awarded to you.
Fixed issue where if the hot potato holder fell off the map, a new hot potato player would not be chosen.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.6
notes.content:
Generic

Changed FPS debug to only show current FPS staggered every half second.

Storymode

Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where the tornado animation would not loop.


Lasertag

Weapon Changes

Accuracy for all fast-firing weapons has been doubled (except the miniguns which were buffed in patch 1.5).
Recoil for every weapon has been decreased by 28%.
Decreased spread on Heart Breaker and Birdseed Shotgun, and increased effective range of Birdseed Shotgun by 50%.
Trooper of the Storm rifle is now less accurate.
Added a simple reload animation.
Arrowed weapons' projectiles now get stuck to the object they hit.
Huntsman snipers now hold 1, 3, and 5 rounds at a time.
Sprayer SMG rank 5 now has a magazine of 25 instead of 425.
Added correct sounds for Bowling Ball of Boom, Flutter Grenade, Propane Tank, and Box O' Tornado.
Meteors from the Meteor Magnatron now deal 25 damage instead of being an instant kill.
Shooting weapons now applies a backward force to the player. This will be useful for traversing in zero  and low gravity.
Due to the uselessness of the Can O' Smoke, it's radius is now 2x larger and does a better job masking players inside.
Stobe On a Stick's radius increased from 10-30 to 30-70.
Hella Cool Blaster's shoot distance has doubled for all rarities.
The tornado will now interact with all physics objects.

Other Changes

You can now see the current match options by pressing 'O' (oh not zero).
Added two more gravity settings: Zero Gravity and Inverted.

Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where the ghost could fall out of bounds and continue falling through the map.
Fixed issue where pressing close on the options menu would not make your cursor disappear.
Fixed issue on Painted Planet where the hot potato could fall off the map and never be seen again.

notes.title: The Big Explosions Update
notes.content:
General

New character: Mini Kangaroo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/5f5c566ae74a36a77566bfc71f60e2618443680b.png
New character: Johnny "The Brick" SIns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/8d42caafad88916fe83a5a2eb4769a43ca8b1210.png

Unlock this brick by owning the rare brick weapon (available in the weapon shoppe)

New character: Mr. White
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/d3f849c3ccc7c145b4613b6ae6d2614388ce523d.png

Say his name. Free for people in the Discord server.

You can unlock King Kangaroo's cutscene crown by placing top 5 for best times on King Kangaroo's Final Showdown. The green wireframe crown for top 3, and the purple wireframe crown for #1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/e4b1715db253bb384ec795a380b7f0cdde12b265.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/386fc73ee817ff97cfdea2b5f41c9a2152e083ec.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/2eb375c0fc40d2382fd0de73d81ef708bf1419e8.png
New awards for leveling up!
The level naming system has been redone and goes up to level 300.
Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where players would appear invisible in the lobby and in lasertag.


Storymode

If you open the map, on the bottom left, you will be able to see your current total meters.
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where collecting an item that is supposed to reduce meters would grant the meters instead.
Fixed cheap juice, snow, and blood tiles from clipping into the side barriers that would cause Z-fighting.

Leaderboards

Timed leaderboards are now formatted correctly.
Leaderboard entries of friends are now marked correctly as a friend.
The Most Eggs In a Single Game and Most Eggs Total Leaderboards have been reset due to an error where eggs were being counted in the credits (where there are an abundance of eggs for those unaware).
Leaderboards are initialized when the game first opens. If you get an error saying there was an error loading the leaderboard, the leaderboard will be reinitialized. Wait a few seconds, and the leaderboard may now show results.

King Kangaroo's Final Showdown

New difficulty: Speedrun:

Same as easy, but distance in between pie spawns is not random.
Time it takes KIng Kangaroo to come out of the lava is not random.

Added a "Restart" button to retry the boss.
Because the health doesn't reset in Easy mode, the stage will not reset to the first stage per checkpoint anymore. This is to prevent you from completely missing some stages. This change is only in Easy mode, not Speedrun.



Lasertag

Stats

Stats are now kept track of and can be seen in the Lasertag matchmaking UI.
Stats will only count if you are not the only player in the lobby.
You will be able to see your current world ranking on K/D and win%.
Awards

Top 3 placement for best K/D is awarded the Purple Wireframe Crown.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/73bbcf4e2d8d1ab2fbb352c50bdbdc72fc92cfbb.png
Top 3 placement for best win% is awarded the Green Wireframe Crown.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/9369cfe324c9baf237a057ebca8c107778285278.png


New Weapons and Gadgets

Air Bombardment Flare
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/63cf19ab66c327f1695694bfbbbaffa8b741daa6.png

A flare that attracts 30 sky missiles that have a larger hit radius than airstrike missiles, have a larger explosion radius than airstrike missiles, and are faster at hitting the ground than airstrike missiles. Overpowered and unfair to say the least.


The Megalodon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/92553ca5869e5f2c058a94bc4c78c2acc96b2f29.png

What's better than 2 rotors and 12 barrels? 3 rotors and 18 barrels. Fire rate of 75 bullets per second.
Unlock this item by reaching level 100.


Homing Missile
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/4f1cc05fd117098ea934fb16a79dec41db45de26.png

Lock onto enemies and send a heat seeking missile towards them!
Unlock this item by completing the Hard... Wicked Hahd storymode challenge.


Barrage Missile
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/a72df84d4e05f76797a38654d7f5fc379d00044a.png

Launch a missile that splits into more missiles that spits into even more missiles!


Rapid Fire Rocket Launcher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/1a59024e51e4c1e7607258194a9b28640ba5d3f9.png

A rocket launcher that can hold 4, 8, or 12 rockets at once. Nice.


Scatter Grenade Launcher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/8463a15e0efc8b7c31b6745a0923b482117ba0b3.png

Shoot a cluster of bouncy grenades.


Dynamite Cannon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/e8d6ece0938d112a0312115b76f688eb25f57df3.png

Shoot sticks of dynamite at friends. Enough said.


Explosive Rifle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/f05d9c1a08471b049ef33be9fadb385097e9bd97.png

A rifle that has explosive bullets. 


Explosive Shotgun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/5b29a68e81bd05c706852cf5eca395677fb1cc8f.png

A shotgun with a pelleted explosive nature.


Propane Tank
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/fc118522558c12fad2b2f2aefb9ebcb2c0ca9640.png

Highly flammable tank that explodes when shot or when other explosions hit it. If you throw it directly at the ground or up in the air, it might explode on impact... it's a propane tank.


Explosive Minigun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/855f9eb19fb6be7a263a71745dc35d1f6d5968ac.png

A minigun that shoots explosive rounds... Stupid, but cool.


Flutter Grenades
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/b4dc013c578ef5d8edb468cf66138e16bad6d649.png

Spinning floating grenades that travel far and take a while to land. Explode on impact or in proximity to another player.


Bowling Ball of Boom
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/f1fb8757baacbe17938387079a202b53a7312b8e.png

The bowling ball that doesn't stop giving. *Stand back when in use.


Special Forces LMG
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/123fc90c590b57daa27e93a6985c60ab206854f5.png

An old time-y light machine gun with better accuracy, but worse recoil.
Unlock this item by reaching level 70.


Trigger Drone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/4091ede4eb7c10eb40d07cb602fe86989b352761.png

Meet Trigger! He would love to make your acquaintance.


Box O' Tornado
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/eb0de84ba2ec11953f6471499693236b1f7ac5f1.png

It's a tornado in a box. What more is there to life?


Meteor Magnatron
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/8bd44be054c0aef4abab3449d432083c5e33abdc.png

A laser rifle that shoots electromagnetic signals at the ground, sending coordinates to orbiting meteorites.



Vehicles

Where we're going... we don't need roads. New Hoverboard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/2c43609998c98316423f189361efd6d139728102.png


Weapon Changes

All snipers, arrowed weapons, explosive launchers, and the airstrike flare now have increased damage.
Adjusted some explosion radii, reload times, and fire rates of some of the grenade launchers to make them better. The machine grenade launcher also has increased magazine from 10-12 to 12-24. 
Grenades now have a larger explosion radius, faster throw rate, and a much further throw force.
Increased explosion radius on most explosive throwables.
All arrowed weapons now have a much faster arrow launch speed.
The bullet spread has been redone on almost all fast-firing weapons to make them more accurate. Except the Trooper of the Storm rifle, which got even less accurate.
All LMGs now have a further effective range before damage starts to drop off.
Sprayer SMG has much faster fire rate and decreased magazine size to make it more unique among the other SMGs.
Baked potato from Hot Potato gamemode now has a faster launch speed and proximity detection where it will hit a player if it gets within a certain radius of them.
Ghost eggs (for ghost spectators) now have a much larger lift force and a larger hit radius.
All shock cannon upgrades now have a better starting blast PSI and increased charge rate.
The brick is now the fastest projectile in the game, going slightly faster than a sniper round. It also has increased damage, because being hit with a 100mph brick is going to hurt.
The Arabian Sword has a 66% larger hit radius.
Box cutter's radius is twice as large and does 10 damage instead of 5.

Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where the Jewel Heist map wouldn't be unloaded when joining a Lasertag match directly from Jewel Heist.
Fixed issue where wins would only be counted if you were the host.
Fixed issue where you could collide with and take damage from fast firing projectiles you shot if you outran them.
You can no longer shoot the C4's proximity collision.
Fixed issue where TNT and C4's stick collision detection would re-trigger every time a new TNT or C4 was thrown onto it, causing them to make a ball.
Fixed collision issue with TNT that would cause them to stack into each other.
Fixed collision issues that prevented players from colliding with projectiles that stayed on the ground.
Fixed visual glitch that showed weapons being different rarities in the Weapon Backpack if you owned the same weapon that was forced of a different rarity.
Fixed issue where projectiles would not have the bullet spread that's listed on their stats.
Fixed the 9 3/4 walls that appeared in Autumn Town, as well as a hole on the edge of the map.
Fire damage now shows up on the responsible arsonist's screen.
Fixed an issue where explosions that tick damage continuously could kill you after you died, causing the game to soft lock.
Fixed a soft lock that occurred when trying to reload a gadget.
Fixed issue where player's usernames would not remain a constant size when aiming in with a weapon.
Fixed an issue where the player join audio would play multiple times when entering a match.
Your weapon will no longer be visible through a scoped weapon when scoping in.
Fixed issue with The Floor Is Lava gamemode where you could stand on or in the lava and be in godmode.
Fixed issue where message would not reflect a no-scope kill when dying to a projectile.
Fixed audio issue where the throwing sound on throwables could be heard from across the map.
Fixed audio issue where hit sound would play when another client's throwable would hit an object.
Fixed issue where the ghost egg would only create an impulse if it hit the player directly.
Fixed issue where Gun Game could not be won.

Other Changes

Text chat is now available! Press 'T' and start chatting away!
There is now an option to select random weapons and gadgets in the weapon selection menu. You can select both everything to be randomized, or a specific type of weapon/gadget.
When you deal damage to someone, their damage will appear over their head as additive damage. For example, if you hit them for 3 and then again for 2, the damage text over their head will show 5 damage total. The damage will disappear after a few seconds.
Damage received now shows up on your screen where damage dealt used to be.
Gun Game now selects 25 random weapons instead of the same set of 25.
Fire has been updated to look slightly more like fire.
Bullet holes now have cool spark effect.
Weapons that fire bullets now dispense shells.
Projectiles now spawn from the end of the barrel or from your hand instead of behind your head.
Increased size and detection radius of several projectiles.
Increased size of muzzle flash.
Added new death messages for when a player is poisoned.
You can now wish everyone in the match a GG by pressing 'G'.
The weapon shoppe now has an option to refresh it with more luck. This will have a greater chance of showing up with items that you don't already own.
In the bottom right of the weapon shoppe, you can now see how many owned weapons you have and how many are left. These stats are for shoppe weapons only, not weapons awarded through storymode.
The hella cool song just got even cooler.
XP will no longer be given after winning if you are the only person in the lobby.

notes.title: The Nutcracker Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
General

New characters: Nutcrackers

5 different styles, 5 different hats, and 1 nutcracker track!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/48ab528573f0e4d6ae689e977ceee2aa80bbbbb3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/a3b5a1a2b837ce0e2eb2933c8ae4d5e5dc160df3.png
New character: Snake
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/672d542fc2e42a424a4a10348033c9081c915667.png
Plank O' Wood has a new crispy style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/8ecd5270ab3e94de128bab72cc2ae61ada3fe57c.png
Changed button UI for core gamemodes to better show what the are.


Storymode

Beehives can now be collected and used with any other collectible.
 Lava tiles now are spread out slightly wider. This will greatly increase the amount of tiles overlapping with the left and right lava barrier, making the edge exploit much harder.
The first gold ring, when collecting a Bucket O' Fish, now appears twice as far away to give players a chance to know what they're supposed to do.
King Kangaroo's Final Showdown

You now get three difficulty options when playing the final showdown. Achievements count in all three difficulties, but only real gamers skip easy...

Easy

Explosive pies in your inventory will never reset.
Pie hits don't reset after King Kangaroo dives back into the lava. The hits will only reset if you die.
King Kangaroo's health does not reset to the previous checkpoint when you die.

Normal

Nothing changed from previous update.

Good Luck, Bub

Original pie timer has been put back into this difficulty. 
Lava density increased from Easy mode density to Normal mode density.
These changes should mimic how the boss was when the game was first released.


Saw blades and logs now spawn at the same distance away every time so there is no longer a chance of gaps being too small to jump in between. This also prevents the saw blades from occasionally making an impassible wall.

Saw blades spawn increased from 18 to 25 to make the saw blade stage still somewhat of a challenge. 


Bug Fixes

White fade screen no longer gets stuck when pausing right as it comes onto the screen.



Lasertag

Increased max players per lobby from 6 to 10.
There is now an option to see all players in the match with the option to send Steam friend requests to them.
Your weapon selection will no longer reset to the default selected weapons after the first round.
You can now shoot thrown items to destroy/explode them.
The Magneto Sucker grappling gun will now pull other players toward you when hit.
Your character now does the Wilhelm scream when you die.
Added several additional random match messages.
When selecting weapons, you have the option to sort weapons between weapon type (rifle, shotgun, sniper, etc.)
Added a sound for when the a new player enters the match.
Added sounds for the cardboard boxes.
Spectator Mode

When you die, you'll now be transformed into a spooky spirit, free to roam around the map.
Spooky Spirits are invisible to all other players,
Spooky Spirits have an unlimited supply of Spooky Eggs. 

There is currently no fire delay when throwing Spooky Eggs. Throw them as fast as you can click.
Spooky Eggs act as a small impulse to players inside its hit radius.


New Custom Game Options

Show Usernames - Steam usernames can be displayed over players in the match.
Team Size - Teams can now be formed!
Rounds - Games can now be split up into rounds that keep track of amount of kills, deaths, and wins. Default is 1 round, but can be set up to 100.
Respawn - You can now choose to respawn for a duration of time or by limiting the number of respawns per player.

New Items

The following items can be found in the weapon shoppe.
Snake Shot Rifle - Fast firing rifle that shoots 5 pellets instead of normal bullets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/08e3973e7e0f709c8805e1aae705658788e4736a.png
Snake Shot Revolver - A revolver that shoots 5 pellets instead of normal bullets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/b50063898101f2572561ad0c9a256b362bbae9a2.png
Toasty Marshmallow Launcher - Shoots fiery marshmallows that ignite enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/d16817fd4b1ff8f1c7b8ba05de2b5ea6c1504901.png
Snowball Launcher - Rapid-fire snowball launcher that reduces enemies' speed and puts out allies on fire.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/0adcb9b361f128330dbf018616a0075e264662f8.png
Surrender Flag - New gadget that shields you from taking damage from bullets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/446dc0afddaa88b99e327c2ddf3d27c0614aed13.png
Oversized Mouse Trap - A large mouse trap that is sure to fool anyone who wants the delicious cheese!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/ccef0d85b213032d2179f5050e64a9115ed657fc.png
Arabian Sword - Slash opponents with this heavy-hitting sword!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/f8eebaa978d8d4fbc253663507120517c2f4f8b0.png
Proximity Drone - A drone that patrols the map. When a player gets into proximity, the drone will chase the player until it gets within its explosion radius.... then KABOOM!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/400a4a5e5dc1095ae6203163da5b38a5f28c90c0.png

New Gamemodes

Hide and Seek - One team gets 20 seconds to hide. Then it's up to the seekers to find and kill the hiders within the 2.5 minute time limit!
Freeze Tag - Each team gets a net launcher and a box cutter. If hit with a net launcher, you cannot move until a teammate (or opponent) slices the net off you. If all of  your team gets caught, you lose!
Arsonists vs. Snowballs - Each team gets a snowball launcher and a toasty marshmallow shooter. The only damage in this mode is from being ignited by the toasty marshmallows which can only be put out by a teammate's (or other opponent's) snowball launcher.
Hot Potato - One unlucky fella has the hot potato. That player has to throw it and hit another player to transfer the potato. The last person holding the potato is exploded. The potato then transfers to another unlucky fella until only one person is left.
Gun Game - The first player to get eliminations with all 25 weapons wins!

Bug Fixes

If you get stuck in the falling animation while your velocity is zero, you will automatically jump to assist in getting unstuck.
Fixed a hole in China Map and added rock formations in ravine to prevent players from being stuck in the bottom. Also fixed some trees that defied gravity.
Weapon names in death feed now use the correct articles "a"/"an".
Win screen is now properly centered and changed losing screen.
Bullet holes no longer appear on thrown items which would leave the bullet holes floating after the thrown item was either removed or rolled away.
Your player no longer gets locked after winning.
Sniper projectiles now create bullet holes.
Fixed a soft lock that occurred when pressing a keybind to a slot that was not occupied.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
Storymode

Items

New Items

Sticky Syrup - Gets your feet sticky preventing you from jumping. Grants 7x more meters than collecting items normally. Available in all collectible gamemodes except Ghost Zone.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36207685/7b40ccdf24d11db06864a56a8be7435d2d891e73.png

Increased Potion O’ Meters spawn in Ghost Zone from 22% to 35%.
Candelabra can now be ‘refueled’ by running into another one mid-flight.
You can now collect other objects when riding the Candelabra.

King Kangaroo’s Final Showdown

King Kangaroo now stays 5 seconds longer after meteors and saws on the third boss wave.
You can now stall spin one time after you deplete your pies. This should help if you want to throw your last pie, but don’t like your current falling path. 
There is no longer a time limit to hit King Kangaroo before his pie hits resets. Instead, his hits will reset when he dives back into the lava.
Wave 2 log toss has been swapped with wave 2 icy track. Log toss grab animation also shortened from 5 seconds to 1 second. These changes are to prevent skipping the log stage completely.
Once you hop onto a meteor, you won’t be able to throw pies until you land on the ground. This is to prevent you from losing all of your pies in order to get through this stage.
Spinning saw spawns in wave 3 decreased from 30 to 18.
Shortened time it takes King Kangaroo to return to his default position after throwing saw blades in wave 3.


Lasertag

Added bullet hit sounds when bullet does not hit the player.

General

Added progress bar to loading screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.content:
Storymode

Collectibles can no longer spawn directly on lava tiles.
Meteorites now have a guaranteed safe path with no lava tiles directly behind them so you can land without fear of dying to hidden lava.
Increased Waffle spawn rate to 0.7% from 0.1%.
Increased Box O’ Juice spawn rate from 9.5% to 11.5%.
Decreased lava density in Ghost Zone to match density of Easy mode.
Achievement ‘Grim Grinning Ghosts’ distance decreased from 100k to 50k meters.
King Kangaroo’s Final Showdown 
Pies now have a maximum spawn distance of 75 meters instead of 100 meters.
Pies inventory no longer gets reset at the start of a new wave.
Decreased lava density to match density of Easy mode.
Decreased Wave 3 fog density by 25%.
